messages:
maria gomez: Heads-up — noticed a weird p95 spike on the latency dashboard for /v1/generate around 11:23. It lines up with a burst of proxy retries. Anyone seen this pattern before?
kevin: yup saw it too, looks like p95 jumps only on the merged endpoint view, not when I break down by backend.
jonas: my hunch: retries are being treated as separate samples when rollups merge routes, which pushes the upper quantiles up.
zara: are retries carrying the same request_id? if so we should be collapsing them at ingestion.
maria gomez: quick dump I ran against the metrics API (for debugging):
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 'https://telemetry.internal/v1/metrics/raw?srv=/v1/generate&from=1745005800&to=1745006200' | jq .samples | head -n 20
# sample format: {"ts": 1745005820, "latency_ms": 482, "request_id": "req_abc", "retry": 1}
```
kevin: thanks — the raw output shows multiple samples with same request_id and different retry counters. t-digest merge doesn't collapse duplicates.
alex: internal API debate: should Metrics API expose a "collapse_retries" query param, or should we do collapse on the ingestion pipeline automatically? collapsing at ingest avoids client mistakes but is irreversible.
jonas: collapse at ingest would change historical percentiles though. Might surprise users.
zara: agree with jonas — better to keep raw data immutable and expose collapse as a query-time transform (cheap to implement as a grouping step).
sre-bot: :rotating_light: alert fired — route=/v1/generate p95+22% vs baseline, sample_count=4123
kevin: UI idea: add an "aggregation mode" pill in the latency view that shows what transform was used (tdigest | raw-samples | collapsed-by-request). Also show a provenance badge per-series so users know which sample source produced this number.
maria gomez: quick local test — grouping by request_id in the query fixes the p95 back to expected: from 720ms -> 180ms. So retries are the culprit.
alex: ok if we add collapse as a query param (default off) the console can enable it by default for endpoint-merged views and show a banner: "Collapsing retries by request_id to avoid percentile inflation". That keeps raw accessible.
jonas: will need to add a note in the API contract and a changelog entry — also add unit tests to t-digest merge path to ensure no accidental double-counting.
zara: UX: tooltip on p95 explaining whether retries are included and an inline link to docs. Also give customers an option in per-tenant settings to toggle default collapse behavior.
maria gomez: I opened PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/telemetry/pulls/1823 — adds ?collapse_retries=true to /v1/metrics/raw and a small console flag. PTAL.
kevin: skimmed PR, looks good. small nit: please include performance benchmark for grouping step (we should avoid making console queries 5x slower).
maria gomez: noted — I ran a perf run: grouping adds ~8% CPU and +120ms for 1M samples; added those numbers to PR description.
alex: cool. next steps: (1) add tests, (2) console feature flag + tooltip, (3) deploy to staging and run canary queries. Who wants to pick up the console work?
zara: I can take console tooltip + feature flag this afternoon.
jonas: I'll add the merge-path tests and a regression harness.
maria gomez: I'll update PR with benchmark tables and address kevin's nit.
sre-bot: deploy to staging complete for telemetry service at 1745007800
alex: thanks team — let's reconvene after staging canary results. :thumbsup:
